name: Abronia bigelovii Heimerl
locality: S of San Ysidro on White Mesa. 10:30 am. Bright, sunny, 80-85º F, no wind. Green seed capsules, leaves in silica gel and flowers/buds in spirits collected. On gypsum slopes with capsules mostly green. Associates include Abronia bigelovii, Ephedra torreyana, dwarf Mentzelia, Gutierrezia microcephala, Coldenia (Boraginaceae), Juniperus monosperma and Quercus undulata.
